name: localbrain
description: Steve's private local AI command center

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run frontend:dev" "npm run backend:dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w backend
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
